candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Very faithful. Uses 〜 (wave dash) in header where image shows ～ (trivial). Table layout with 接続の形：/［普通形］/ものの columns matches the boxed layout well; 「ただし　Nである」 kept together as in the image. Full-width brackets ［］ preserved. Extra space in 「Xものの Y」 is a minor deviation.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Accurate text; correct ～. Inconsistent bracket width: [普通形] rendered half-width while ［で］／［な］ full-width. Table places 「ただし」 in the first column of its own row, splitting it from Nである, which slightly misrepresents the indented sub-note layout. Otherwise complete and clean.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes:
Substitutes 【】 for the image's ［］ brackets throughout (【普通形】,【で】,【な】), a real character-level deviation. Table merges 接続の形：【普通形】 into one cell and puts both Nである and ナ形 lines under 「ただし」 via
, losing the layout where ものの stands beside the whole conjugation column. Body paragraph accurate.

rationale: All three transcribe the explanatory paragraph correctly with no hallucinations. A is best: it preserves the full-width square brackets, keeps 「ただし　Nである」 together matching the boxed layout, and structures the table with ものの correctly to the side; its only flaws are the 〜 variant and a stray space. B is close behind but uses a half-width bracket inconsistently for [普通形] and separates ただし into its own column cell, slightly distorting the layout. C ranks last because it replaces all square brackets with lenticular 【】 brackets (a character-accuracy error affecting multiple tokens) and its table structure less faithfully represents the box, with ものの confined to one row instead of spanning.
